title: 1.4.4 Resize Text Mini-assessment
description: Complete after the required lesson activity.

elements.name: q1
elements.title: How far must text generally resize without loss?
elements.feedback: The criterion requires resizing up to 200 percent without loss of content or functionality.

elements.name: q2
elements.title: A label is clipped at 200 percent. Is the criterion satisfied?
elements.feedback: Clipping loses content even when the control remains operable.

elements.name: q3
elements.title: Do relative CSS units alone prove compliance?
elements.feedback: Test the resulting content and functionality.
